No dedicated storage for MUS1-4 or LIB1-5/LIB2-5/LIB3-5; SoA storage budget of 7 fully consumed.
STAFF5-5/STAFF6-5/STAFF7-4 placed on upper floors; admin-first rule (R1) satisfied for 4 of 7 on G/F.
